deals.headline: NBA approves sale of Timberwolves and Lynx to Lore and Rodriguez
deals.summary: The NBA Board of Governors unanimously approved Glen Taylor's sale of the Timberwolves and Lynx to Marc Lore and Alex Rodriguez. The 2021 agreement called for a first payment at a $1.5bn valuation and three later payments at 4% escalators; $942M for the final two payments was held in escrow at JPMorgan.

ownership_summary: Marc Lore and Alex Rodriguez completed their purchase of the Timberwolves and Lynx from Glen Taylor in June 2025 after NBA approval (a 2021 agreement at a $1.5bn first-payment valuation, later contested in arbitration); Mike Bloomberg and Eric Schmidt joined their cap table. In August 2026 limited partner Marc Stad (founder of Dragoneer Investment Group) agreed to buy Lore's control stake at a $4.5bn enterprise value; Lore stays a limited partner, Rodriguez stays and reportedly increases his stake, and Elisa Stad is to be the NBA team's governor. That deal still required league approval when reported. Blue Owl's Dyal HomeCourt Partners has held an undisclosed minority stake since 2021.
